title: ID0448648-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170002000] Charging Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue: The driver reported charging problems. Therefore, we conducted
another charging test last evening.
4:04 PM Outlet 2 - Error
4:06 PM Outlet 2 - Error
4:07 PM Outlet 2 - Error
4:08 PM Outlet 2 - Error
4:10 PM Outlet 4 ...successful 245 kW
From 5:16 PM, we tested various outlets.
5:18 PM Outlet 3 - OK
5:20 PM Outlet 2 - Error
5:23 PM Outlet 1 - Error
5:25 PM Outlet 3 - OK
-> At the main station, no connection can be established at either
outlet (sometimes no steps/circles, sometimes time out at circle 2),
-> at the dispenser, a connection is almost possible without
problems.
-> This Iveco has been able to charge everywhere in the last few
weeks - also with the old but stable version 7.0.5
-> Is it more likely a problem with Iveco or the charging station?
Do you have any suggestions for Iveco

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0448648-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170002000] Charging Error CRM:02832000412
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
We have additional information to share with you.
We reviewed all sessions since the afternoon of September 8. For Outlet 2, all sessions involving Volvo trucks were successful except for . The failed session appears to be due to a failed BCB toggle, as this vehicle was charging just before, and the session was ended by the EV. The subsequent session (the failed one) did not complete authorization. We believe this issue is because the charger does not have the BCB feature enabled on the backend side (TxStopPoint configuration key).
Regarding the IVECO truck in Outlet 2, the truck with MAC address 5c.cc.a0.02.62.87 shows a high failure rate, although some sessions were successful. Upon reviewing the failed sessions, the charging interruptions seem to result from the vehicle closing TCP communication without any clear reason.
We are still waiting for more data from Outlet 1 following the SECC reboot to determine if communication has returned to normal.
We look forward to your feedback.
Best regards,
Mora, Catalina (SI E CS SD ES)

additional_info.subject: AW: 0448648 - ID0448648-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170002000] Charging Error CRM:00439000933
additional_info.body:
Hallo Siemens,
am Mittwoch war ein Techniker von Energu da und hat die Wartung beider Ladesäulen durchgeführt (DGUV, Filtertauch, Reinigung). Seitdem scheint auch Outlet #1 wieder zu funktionieren – mit PKW, Iveco und Volvo. Ob es ein Zufall ist, wissen wir nicht. Wir werden es Anfang nächster Woche weiter beobachten und uns bei Problemen umgehend melden.
Nachdem die Ladesäule aktuell wieder läuft, braucht es das Update auf V8 NICHT, von unserer Anwendersicht vorerst auch nicht den geplanten Techniker. Das Update auf die nächste Version wollen wir unbedingt vermeiden, da wir beim letzten Major Update gravierende Nachteile hatten.
Wir wünschen Ihnen ein schönes Wochenende.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
